decisions.choice: the first return from exile, led by Zerubbabel and Jeshua
decisions.reason: Zerubbabel, of the royal line of David, and Jeshua the high priest led the first group of exiles home from Babylon after Cyrus allowed it in about 538 BC (Ezra 1:1-4; 2:2; 3:2). The chapter goes back almost a century before Nehemiah's own time to list the priestly and Levite families from then until his day (verse 26).

decisions.choice: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra: heads of priestly families, not the prophet or the scribe
decisions.reason: These names head priestly families of the first return; most of them come back as family names in verses 12-21 and among those who signed the pledge in 10:3-9. This Jeremiah is not the prophet, and this Ezra lived some eighty years before Ezra the scribe, who came to Jerusalem in about 458 BC (Ezra 7:1-8).

decisions.choice: one list running through verse 7
decisions.reason: The list of priests begins here and closes in verse 7 with "these were the heads of the priests". The Literal and Balanced levels end each verse with a comma so the list reads as one sentence.

decisions.choice: came back from exile; The priests were
decisions.reason: "Went up" is the usual word for returning from Babylon to Jerusalem; Readable says what it means and starts the list as its own sentence. Verse 8 begins the Levites.

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("montèrent"); passé composé at Readable ("sont revenus")
decisions.reason: For the narrative of this chapter, as in Ezra and the rest of Nehemiah: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the tense most readers use today. Nehemiah's own account (from verse 31) follows the same rule.

decisions.choice: the list is introduced with a closed sentence ("…다음과 같다") and the names run on with commas to verse 7
alternatives: one Korean sentence ending only in verse 7
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so the sentence that names the group closes here and the names follow as a list, as the English Literal and Balanced keep the list open across verses 1-7 (m3).

decisions.choice: Zorobabel, filho de Salatiel; Jesua
decisions.reason: As Ezra 2:2 and 3:2 in Portuguese (m1). Esdras here is the head of a priestly family of the first return (m2), but the name keeps the one Portuguese form.

decisions.choice: the priestly family names of verses 1-21: names already drafted keep that form (Seraías, Jeremias, Esdras, Amarias, Maluque, Hatus, Secanias, Reum, Meremote, Ido, Ginetom, Abias, Miamim, Miniamim, Bilga, Semaías, Joiaribe, Jedaías, Salu, Hilquias, Harim, Meraiote, Mesulão, Zacarias, Zicri, Samua, Uzi, Salai, Hasabias, Natanael, Hananias, Jônatas, José); the rarer ones are given here (Ginetoi, Maadias, Amoque, Meraías, Jeoanã, Meliqui, Adna, Helcai, Piltai, Jeônatas, Matenai, Calai, Éber)
decisions.reason: The families of verses 1-7 return in verses 12-21, some with another spelling in the Hebrew (Malluch and Mellichu, Mijamin and Miniamin, Ginnethon and Ginnethoi, Sallu and Sallai); Portuguese writes each spelling as the Hebrew has it, as the English does, so a reader can follow the meaning notes. The rare forms follow the patterns of Ezra 2 and are a first proposal.

decisions.choice: the songs of thanksgiving
decisions.reason: The word is rare, found only here, and comes from the verb "to give thanks". Mattaniah is named in 11:17 as the one who led the thanksgiving in prayer, so the songs are the thanksgiving sung in worship.

decisions.choice: he and his brothers: Mattaniah and his fellow Levites
decisions.reason: "He" points back to Mattaniah, the last name, who led the singers (11:17). "His brothers" are the Levite singers with him, set over against those of verse 9.

decisions.choice: Jeshua the Levite
decisions.reason: This Jeshua is a Levite, not Jeshua the high priest of verse 1; the name was common (Ezra 2:40; 3:9).

decisions.choice: led the songs of thanks to God
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the thanks are given, as verse 46 does.

decisions.choice: "그와 그의 형제들이 … 맡았다" as a second sentence at Literal
decisions.reason: Korean cannot hang "[who was] over the songs, he and his brothers" after the last name of a list; Literal closes the list and gives the clause its own verb, keeping the Hebrew's words.

decisions.choice: os cânticos de ação de graças (L, B); os cânticos de gratidão (R)
decisions.reason: The rare word is the thanksgiving sung in worship (m1). "Ação de graças" is the Portuguese of worship for it, kept for the choirs of verses 27-40; Readable says "gratidão", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: Unni, as the text is read
decisions.reason: The written consonants of this name differ slightly from the way the text is read; the Masoretes noted the reading in the margin (the qere), and this translation follows it, as the source data does. The person meant is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the two groups answered each other in song

decisions.choice: the line of the high priests
decisions.reason: Verses 10-11 trace the high priests from Jeshua, at the return (verse 1), to Jaddua. Eliashib was high priest in Nehemiah's time and helped rebuild the wall (3:1); his family's ties to Tobiah and Sanballat come up in 13:4 and 13:28.

decisions.reason: The verb means "caused to be born", "became the father of". The Hebrew leaves it out the third time; Balanced supplies it, Literal follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Joiacim", "Joiada" for the high priests
decisions.reason: The short Hebrew forms, kept apart from King Jehoiakim ("Joacim") as the terms note asks.

decisions.reason: The short Hebrew form, kept apart from King Jehoiakim ("Joïaqim") as the terms note asks.

decisions.choice: Jonathan, perhaps the Johanan of verses 22-23
decisions.reason: Verses 22-23 name Johanan after Joiada and before Jaddua, and call him "son of Eliashib", perhaps meaning grandson. Jonathan and Johanan are different names, so either the same man is meant and one spelling arose in copying, or the list skips a generation. A Persian-period letter found at Elephantine in Egypt (407 BC) names a high priest Johanan in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: the next generation, family by family
decisions.reason: Joiakim was the high priest after Jeshua (verse 10). Verses 12-21 go through the priestly families of verses 1-7 in nearly the same order and give the head of each one a generation later: the family name first, then its head.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers: heads of fathers' houses
decisions.reason: "Fathers" is short for "fathers' houses", the extended families of a clan (see Numbers 1:2).

decisions.choice: of (Balanced); for, led the family of (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each pair is a family and its head; Readable writes out the relation so the list is not mistaken for father and son.

decisions.choice: "en la de Seraías, Meraías" (Balanced), through verse 21
decisions.reason: Balanced makes plain that each pair is a family and its head ("en la [familia] de"), where the English says "for"; Literal keeps the bare "de".

decisions.choice: "họ Sê-ra-gia có Mê-ra-gia" (Balanced), through verse 21
decisions.reason: A bare "của" between two names would read as father and son; Balanced names the family ("họ") and its head ("có"), Readable says "lãnh đạo gia tộc".

decisions.choice: "스라야에게는 므라야" (Literal), "스라야 가문에는 므라야" (Balanced), through verse 21
decisions.reason: "스라야의 므라야" would read as "Seraiah's son Meraiah"; Literal marks the family with -에게는, Balanced names it as a 가문.

decisions.choice: de X, Y (L); pela família de X, Y (B); Y chefiava a família de X (R)
decisions.reason: For verses 12-21: one formula per level. Each pair is a family and its head a generation later (m1). Portuguese "de Seraías, Meraías" at Balanced could be read as father and son, so Balanced says "pela família de", and Readable writes out the relation, as the English Readable does.

source.text: הַלְוִיִּם֩ בִּימֵ֨י אֶלְיָשִׁ֜יב יוֹיָדָ֤ע וְיוֹחָנָן֙ וְיַדּ֔וּעַ כְּתוּבִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י אָב֑וֹת וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים עַל־מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַפָּֽרְסִֽי׃פ

records.literal_gloss: The Levites, in [the] days of Eliashib, Joiada and Johanan and Jaddua, [were] recorded [as] heads of fathers, and the priests, in [the] reign of Darius the Persian.

en.L: The Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada and Johanan and Jaddua, [were] recorded [as] heads of fathers' [houses], and the priests, until the reign of Darius the Persian.
en.B: In the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, the Levites were recorded by the heads of their fathers' houses, and so were the priests, up to the reign of Darius the Persian.
en.R: The leaders of the Levite families were written down in the records while Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua were high priests. The priests were written down too, up to the time when Darius the Persian was king.

es.L: Los levitas, en los días de Eliasib, Joiada y Johanán y Jadúa, [fueron] inscritos [como] jefes de [casas] paternas, y los sacerdotes, hasta el reinado de Darío el persa.
es.B: En los días de Eliasib, Joiada, Johanán y Jadúa, los levitas fueron inscritos según los jefes de sus casas paternas, y también los sacerdotes, hasta el reinado de Darío el persa.
es.R: Los jefes de las familias levitas quedaron anotados en los registros mientras Eliasib, Joiada, Johanán y Jadúa eran sumos sacerdotes. También se anotó a los sacerdotes, hasta el tiempo en que Darío el persa era rey.

fr.L: Les Lévites, aux jours d’Éliashib, Yoyada, et Yohanân, et Yaddoua, [furent] inscrits [comme] chefs de [maisons] paternelles, ainsi que les prêtres, jusqu’au règne de Darius le Perse.
fr.B: Au temps d’Éliashib, de Yoyada, de Yohanân et de Yaddoua, les Lévites furent inscrits selon les chefs de leurs familles, et les prêtres aussi, jusqu’au règne de Darius le Perse.
fr.R: Les chefs des familles de Lévites ont été inscrits dans les registres pendant qu’Éliashib, Yoyada, Yohanân et Yaddoua étaient grands prêtres. Les prêtres aussi ont été inscrits, jusqu’à l’époque où Darius le Perse était roi.

sw.L: Walawi, katika siku za Eliashibu, Yoyada na Yohana na Yadua, [waliandikwa kuwa] wakuu wa [nyumba za] baba, na makuhani, mpaka utawala wa Dario Mwajemi.
sw.B: Katika siku za Eliashibu, Yoyada, Yohana na Yadua, Walawi waliandikwa kwa kufuata wakuu wa nyumba za baba zao, na makuhani vilevile, mpaka utawala wa Dario Mwajemi.
sw.R: Viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi waliandikwa katika kumbukumbu wakati Eliashibu, Yoyada, Yohana na Yadua walipokuwa makuhani wakuu. Makuhani nao waliandikwa, mpaka wakati Dario Mwajemi alipokuwa mfalme.

vi.L: Người Lê-vi, trong những ngày của Ê-li-a-síp, Giô-gia-đa, và Giô-ha-nan, và Gia-đua, [được] ghi chép [là] những người đứng đầu [nhà] tổ phụ, cùng các thầy tế lễ, cho đến triều đại Đa-ri-út người Ba Tư.
vi.B: Trong thời Ê-li-a-síp, Giô-gia-đa, Giô-ha-nan và Gia-đua, người Lê-vi được ghi vào sổ theo các trưởng tộc của họ, các thầy tế lễ cũng vậy, cho đến triều đại Đa-ri-út người Ba Tư.
vi.R: Những người đứng đầu các gia tộc Lê-vi được ghi vào sổ sách trong thời Ê-li-a-síp, Giô-gia-đa, Giô-ha-nan và Gia-đua làm thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. Các thầy tế lễ cũng được ghi vào sổ, cho đến thời vua Đa-ri-út người Ba Tư trị vì.

ko.L: 레위 사람들은, 엘리아십과 요야다와 요하난과 얏두아의 날들에, 조상[의 가문들]의 우두머리들[로] 기록되었고, 제사장들도 페르시아 사람 다리오의 통치[까지 그러했다].
ko.B: 엘리아십, 요야다, 요하난, 얏두아 때에 레위 사람들은 가문의 우두머리별로 기록되었고, 제사장들도 페르시아 사람 다리오가 다스릴 때까지 그렇게 기록되었다.
ko.R: 엘리아십, 요야다, 요하난, 얏두아가 대제사장이었을 때 레위 가문의 지도자들이 기록에 올랐다. 제사장들도 페르시아 사람 다리오가 왕이었던 때까지 기록에 올랐다.

pt.L: Os levitas, nos dias de Eliasibe, Joiada, e Joanã, e Jadua, [foram] registrados [como] chefes dos pais, e os sacerdotes, até o reinado de Dario, o persa.
pt.B: Nos dias de Eliasibe, Joiada, Joanã e Jadua, os levitas foram registrados pelos chefes das suas famílias, e também os sacerdotes, até o reinado de Dario, o persa.
pt.R: Os líderes das famílias dos levitas foram anotados nos registros enquanto Eliasibe, Joiada, Joanã e Jadua eram sumos sacerdotes. Os sacerdotes também foram anotados, até o tempo em que Dario, o persa, era rei.

decisions.choice: Darius the Persian: probably Darius II
decisions.reason: Three Persian kings were named Darius. The high priests named here (verses 10-11) lived after Nehemiah's time, which fits Darius II (423-404 BC). If Jaddua is the high priest of Alexander the Great's time known from later Jewish history, Darius III (336-330 BC) would be meant. The text does not say which.

decisions.choice: in the reign of: up to the reign of
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "in", "during" or "up to". With a list of four high priests across several generations, the record reached up to the reign of this Darius.

decisions.choice: heads of fathers: heads of fathers' houses
decisions.reason: As in verse 12, the heads of the extended families.

decisions.choice: while ... were high priests
decisions.reason: Readable says who these four men were (verses 10-11).

decisions.choice: "Yohana" for Johanan
decisions.reason: The published Swahili form of Johanan (Jeremiah 40-43); Jehohanan in verse 13 keeps the longer "Yehohanani", as Ezra 10:6 does.

decisions.choice: Joanã; Dario, o persa
decisions.reason: "Joanã" is the Portuguese form of Johanan, as 1 Chronicles 3:15 and 2 Kings 25:23; "Jeoanã" is kept for the longer Hebrew form (verses 13, 42). Darius keeps the form of Ezra 4-6 in Portuguese (m1).

source.text: בְּנֵ֤י לֵוִי֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת כְּתוּבִ֕ים עַל־סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֑ים וְעַד־יְמֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃

records.literal_gloss: The sons of Levi, heads of the fathers, [were] recorded on [the] scroll of [the] matters of the days, and until [the] days of Johanan son of Eliashib.

en.L: The sons of Levi, heads of the fathers' [houses], [were] recorded in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan son of Eliashib.
en.B: The descendants of Levi, the heads of fathers' houses, were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles, up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib.
en.R: The leaders of Levi's families were written down in the official record of events, up to the time of Johanan, Eliashib's grandson.

es.L: Los hijos de Leví, jefes de [casas] paternas, [fueron] inscritos en el libro de las crónicas, hasta los días de Johanán hijo de Eliasib.
es.B: Los descendientes de Leví, jefes de casas paternas, fueron inscritos en el Libro de las Crónicas, hasta los días de Johanán hijo de Eliasib.
es.R: Los jefes de las familias de Leví quedaron anotados en el registro oficial de los acontecimientos, hasta el tiempo de Johanán, nieto de Eliasib.

fr.L: Les fils de Lévi, chefs de [maisons] paternelles, [furent] inscrits dans le livre des chroniques, jusqu’aux jours de Yohanân, fils d’Éliashib.
fr.B: Les descendants de Lévi, chefs de famille, furent inscrits dans le Livre des Chroniques, jusqu’au temps de Yohanân, fils d’Éliashib.
fr.R: Les chefs des familles de Lévi ont été inscrits dans le registre officiel des événements, jusqu’à l’époque de Yohanân, petit-fils d’Éliashib.

sw.L: Wana wa Lawi, wakuu wa [nyumba za] baba, [waliandikwa] katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku, hata mpaka siku za Yohana mwana wa Eliashibu.
sw.B: Wazao wa Lawi, wakuu wa nyumba za baba zao, waliandikwa katika Kitabu cha Mambo ya Nyakati, mpaka siku za Yohana mwana wa Eliashibu.
sw.R: Viongozi wa jamaa za Lawi waliandikwa katika kumbukumbu rasmi ya matukio, mpaka wakati wa Yohana, mjukuu wa Eliashibu.

vi.L: Con cái Lê-vi, những người đứng đầu [nhà] tổ phụ, [được] ghi chép trong sách sử ký, cho đến những ngày của Giô-ha-nan con trai Ê-li-a-síp.
vi.B: Con cháu Lê-vi, những trưởng tộc, được ghi vào Sách Sử Ký, cho đến thời Giô-ha-nan con trai Ê-li-a-síp.
vi.R: Những người đứng đầu các gia tộc Lê-vi được ghi trong sổ chính thức ghi lại các biến cố, cho đến thời Giô-ha-nan, cháu nội của Ê-li-a-síp.

ko.L: 레위의 아들들, 곧 조상[의 가문들]의 우두머리들은 엘리아십의 아들 요하난의 날들까지 그날들의 일들의 책에 기록되었다.
ko.B: 레위의 자손들, 곧 가문의 우두머리들은 엘리아십의 아들 요하난 때까지 연대기에 기록되었다.
ko.R: 레위 가문의 지도자들은 엘리아십의 손자 요하난 때까지 공식 기록에 올랐다.

pt.L: Os filhos de Levi, chefes dos pais, [foram] registrados no livro das crônicas, até os dias de Joanã, filho de Eliasibe.
pt.B: Os descendentes de Levi, os chefes das famílias, foram registrados no Livro das Crônicas, até os dias de Joanã, filho de Eliasibe.
pt.R: Os líderes das famílias de Levi foram anotados no registro oficial dos acontecimentos, até o tempo de Joanã, neto de Eliasibe.

decisions.choice: the scroll of the matters of the days: an official record of events
decisions.reason: "The matters of the days" means the events of each year, a chronicle. It was a record kept in Jerusalem, not necessarily the biblical book of Chronicles, though that book has the same Hebrew name and lists the Levites (1 Chronicles 23-26).

decisions.choice: son of Eliashib: descendant, here grandson
decisions.reason: By verses 10-11 Johanan (or Jonathan) was Eliashib's grandson, son of Joiada. "Son" in Hebrew can name any male descendant.

decisions.choice: Eliashib's grandson
decisions.reason: Readable follows verses 10-11 so the reader is not confused by the two lists.

decisions.choice: "연대기" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "역대기" is the Korean title of the biblical book of Chronicles; the meaning decision (m1) says this was a record kept in Jerusalem, not necessarily that book, so Balanced uses the general word for a chronicle.

decisions.choice: o livro das crônicas (L); o Livro das Crônicas (B); o registro oficial dos acontecimentos (R)
decisions.reason: An official record kept in Jerusalem (m1), named as the English names it at each level: lowercase at Literal, as a title at Balanced, as the records of the kings are "o Livro das Crônicas dos Reis" in Portuguese, and described at Readable.

source.text: וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הַ֠לְוִיִּם חֲשַׁבְיָ֨ה שֵֽׁרֵבְיָ֜ה וְיֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־קַדְמִיאֵל֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֣ם לְנֶגְדָּ֔ם לְהַלֵּ֣ל לְהוֹד֔וֹת בְּמִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] heads of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah and Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their brothers opposite them, to praise, to give thanks by [the] command of David, [the] man of God, watch alongside watch.

en.L: And the heads of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah and Jeshua son of Kadmiel, with their brothers opposite them, to praise and to give thanks, as David the man of God had commanded, watch beside watch.
en.B: The leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua son of Kadmiel. Their fellow Levites stood opposite them to praise and give thanks, one group answering the other, as David the man of God had commanded.
en.R: The leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua son of Kadmiel. Other Levites stood facing them. Together they praised God and thanked him, one group answering the other, as King David, the man of God, had ordered long before.

es.L: Y los jefes de los levitas [eran] Hasabías, Serebías y Jesúa hijo de Cadmiel, con sus hermanos frente a ellos, para alabar y dar gracias, según el mandato de David, hombre de Dios, turno junto a turno.
es.B: Los jefes de los levitas eran Hasabías, Serebías y Jesúa hijo de Cadmiel. Sus compañeros levitas se colocaban frente a ellos para alabar y dar gracias, un grupo respondiendo al otro, como lo había mandado David, el hombre de Dios.
es.R: Los jefes de los levitas eran Hasabías, Serebías y Jesúa hijo de Cadmiel. Otros levitas se ponían frente a ellos. Juntos alababan a Dios y le daban gracias, un grupo respondiendo al otro, como lo había ordenado mucho antes el rey David, el hombre de Dios.

fr.L: Et les chefs des Lévites [étaient] Hashabia, Shérébia et Yeshoua, fils de Qadmiel, avec leurs frères en face d’eux, pour louer et pour rendre grâce, selon le commandement de David, l’homme de Dieu, garde à côté de garde.
fr.B: Les chefs des Lévites étaient Hashabia, Shérébia et Yeshoua, fils de Qadmiel. Leurs frères lévites se tenaient en face d’eux pour louer et rendre grâce, un groupe répondant à l’autre, comme l’avait ordonné David, l’homme de Dieu.
fr.R: Les chefs des Lévites étaient Hashabia, Shérébia et Yeshoua, fils de Qadmiel. D’autres Lévites se tenaient en face d’eux. Ensemble, ils louaient Dieu et le remerciaient, un groupe répondant à l’autre, comme le roi David, l’homme de Dieu, l’avait ordonné bien longtemps avant.

sw.L: Na wakuu wa Walawi [walikuwa] Hashabia, Sherebia na Yeshua mwana wa Kadmieli, pamoja na ndugu zao kuwakabili, ili kusifu na kushukuru, kwa amri ya Daudi mtu wa Mungu, zamu karibu na zamu.
sw.B: Viongozi wa Walawi walikuwa Hashabia, Sherebia na Yeshua mwana wa Kadmieli. Walawi wenzao walisimama kuwakabili ili kusifu na kushukuru, kundi moja likilijibu jingine, kama Daudi mtu wa Mungu alivyoamuru.
sw.R: Viongozi wa Walawi walikuwa Hashabia, Sherebia na Yeshua mwana wa Kadmieli. Walawi wengine walisimama wakiwatazama. Kwa pamoja walimsifu Mungu na kumshukuru, kundi moja likilijibu jingine, kama Mfalme Daudi, mtu wa Mungu, alivyoamuru zamani.

vi.L: Và những người đứng đầu người Lê-vi [là] Ha-sa-bia, Sê-rê-bia và Giê-sua con trai Cát-mi-ên, cùng anh em họ đối diện với họ, để ca ngợi và cảm tạ, theo lệnh của Đa-vít, người của Đức Chúa Trời, ban bên cạnh ban.
vi.B: Những người lãnh đạo người Lê-vi là Ha-sa-bia, Sê-rê-bia và Giê-sua con trai Cát-mi-ên. Anh em Lê-vi của họ đứng đối diện để ca ngợi và cảm tạ, nhóm này đáp lại nhóm kia, theo như Đa-vít, người của Đức Chúa Trời, đã truyền dạy.
vi.R: Những người lãnh đạo người Lê-vi là Ha-sa-bia, Sê-rê-bia và Giê-sua con trai Cát-mi-ên. Những người Lê-vi khác đứng đối diện với họ. Họ cùng nhau ca ngợi và cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời, nhóm này đáp lại nhóm kia, đúng như vua Đa-vít, người của Đức Chúa Trời, đã truyền từ lâu.

ko.L: 그리고 레위 사람들의 우두머리들은 하사뱌, 세레뱌, 갓미엘의 아들 예수아[였고], 그들의 형제들은 그들 맞은편에 [서서], 하나님의 사람 다윗의 명령에 따라, 반열 곁에 반열이 찬양하고 감사했다.
ko.B: 레위 사람들의 지도자들은 하사뱌, 세레뱌, 갓미엘의 아들 예수아였다. 그들의 동료 레위 사람들은 하나님의 사람 다윗이 명령한 대로 그들 맞은편에 서서, 한 무리가 다른 무리에 화답하며 찬양하고 감사했다.
ko.R: 레위 사람들의 지도자들은 하사뱌, 세레뱌, 갓미엘의 아들 예수아였다. 다른 레위 사람들은 그들을 마주 보고 섰다. 그들은 오래전에 하나님의 사람 다윗 왕이 명령한 대로, 한 무리가 다른 무리에 화답하며 함께 하나님을 찬양하고 감사드렸다.

pt.L: E os chefes dos levitas [eram] Hasabias, Serebias e Jesua, filho de Cadmiel, com os seus irmãos diante deles, para louvar e para dar graças, segundo a ordem de Davi, o homem de Deus, turno ao lado de turno.
pt.B: Os líderes dos levitas eram Hasabias, Serebias e Jesua, filho de Cadmiel. Os seus companheiros levitas ficavam de frente para eles para louvar e dar graças, um grupo respondendo ao outro, como Davi, o homem de Deus, tinha ordenado.
pt.R: Os líderes dos levitas eram Hasabias, Serebias e Jesua, filho de Cadmiel. Outros levitas ficavam de frente para eles. Juntos louvavam e agradeciam a Deus, um grupo respondendo ao outro, como o rei Davi, o homem de Deus, tinha ordenado muito tempo antes.

decisions.choice: the command of David, the man of God
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 23-25 tells how David organized the Levites and the singers into divisions to praise and give thanks. "Man of God" is the title of a prophet; David is called so in 2 Chronicles 8:14 and in verse 36.

decisions.choice: watch beside watch: group answering group
decisions.reason: The words mean one division of singers corresponding to another, the answering song of verse 9.

decisions.choice: Jeshua son of Kadmiel, perhaps Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Jeshua, Binnui and Kadmiel are three Levites named together (verse 8; 10:10). The Hebrew word for "son of" and the name Binnui look alike, so the list may first have read "Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel". The text as it stands is translated.

decisions.choice: praised God and thanked him; King David ... long before
decisions.reason: Readable names the one praised and says who David was.

decisions.choice: turno ao lado de turno (L); um grupo respondendo ao outro (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means one division of singers answering another (m2). Literal keeps the Hebrew "watch" as "turno", the word for a shift of duty; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as Ezra 3:11 does in Portuguese for the same answering song. "O homem de Deus" as Ezra 3:2.

source.text: מַתַּנְיָ֧ה וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֛ה עֹבַדְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם טַלְמ֣וֹן עַקּ֑וּב שֹׁמְרִ֤ים שֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ מִשְׁמָ֔ר בַּאֲסֻפֵּ֖י הַשְּׁעָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Mattaniah and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, keeping guard [as] gatekeepers at the storehouses of the gates.

en.L: Mattaniah and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub [were] gatekeepers keeping guard at the storehouses of the gates.
en.B: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers who stood guard at the storerooms by the gates.
en.R: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers. They guarded the storerooms next to the gates.

es.L: Matanías y Bacbuquías, Abdías, Mesulam, Talmón, Acub [eran] porteros que montaban guardia en los almacenes de las puertas.
es.B: Matanías, Bacbuquías, Abdías, Mesulam, Talmón y Acub eran porteros que hacían guardia en los almacenes junto a las puertas.
es.R: Matanías, Bacbuquías, Abdías, Mesulam, Talmón y Acub eran porteros. Vigilaban los almacenes que estaban junto a las puertas.

fr.L: Mattania et Baqbouqia, Abdias, Meshoullam, Talmôn, Aqqoub [étaient] portiers, montant la garde aux magasins des portes.
fr.B: Mattania, Baqbouqia, Abdias, Meshoullam, Talmôn et Aqqoub étaient portiers et montaient la garde aux magasins près des portes.
fr.R: Mattania, Baqbouqia, Abdias, Meshoullam, Talmôn et Aqqoub étaient portiers. Ils surveillaient les réserves situées près des portes.

sw.L: Matania na Bakbukia, Obadia, Meshulamu, Talmoni, Akubu [walikuwa] mabawabu wakilinda kwenye ghala za malango.
sw.B: Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Meshulamu, Talmoni na Akubu walikuwa mabawabu waliolinda ghala zilizokuwa karibu na malango.
sw.R: Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Meshulamu, Talmoni na Akubu walikuwa walinzi wa malango. Walilinda ghala zilizokuwa karibu na malango.

vi.L: Mát-ta-nia và Bác-bu-kia, Áp-đia, Mê-su-lam, Thanh-môn, A-cúp [là] những người giữ cổng canh gác tại các kho của các cổng.
vi.B: Mát-ta-nia, Bác-bu-kia, Áp-đia, Mê-su-lam, Thanh-môn và A-cúp là những người giữ cổng, canh gác các kho bên cạnh các cổng.
vi.R: Mát-ta-nia, Bác-bu-kia, Áp-đia, Mê-su-lam, Thanh-môn và A-cúp là những người giữ cổng. Họ canh giữ các nhà kho cạnh các cổng.

ko.L: 맛다냐와 박부갸, 오바댜, 므술람, 달몬, 악굽은 문들의 곳간들을 지키는 문지기들[이었다].
ko.B: 맛다냐, 박부갸, 오바댜, 므술람, 달몬, 악굽은 문 곁에 있는 곳간들을 지키는 문지기들이었다.
ko.R: 맛다냐, 박부갸, 오바댜, 므술람, 달몬, 악굽은 문지기였다. 그들은 문 옆에 있는 창고들을 지켰다.

pt.L: Matanias e Baquebuquias, Obadias, Mesulão, Talmom, Acube [eram] porteiros que faziam a guarda nos depósitos das portas.
pt.B: Matanias, Baquebuquias, Obadias, Mesulão, Talmom e Acube eram porteiros que montavam guarda nos depósitos junto às portas.
pt.R: Matanias, Baquebuquias, Obadias, Mesulão, Talmom e Acube eram porteiros. Eles guardavam os depósitos que ficavam ao lado das portas.

decisions.choice: who the gatekeepers were
decisions.reason: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah and probably Obadiah were singers (verses 8-9; 11:17), while Talmon and Akkub were gatekeepers (11:19). The verse may join two groups, the first three closing the singers of verse 24 and the last three being gatekeepers, or these men may have served in both ways. The Hebrew sets them in one list.

decisions.choice: the storehouses of the gates
decisions.reason: Store rooms built at or beside the temple gates, where the gifts of verse 44 were kept (compare 1 Chronicles 26:15).

source.text: אֵ֕לֶּה בִּימֵ֛י יוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־יֵשׁ֖וּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָ֑ק וּבִימֵי֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה הַפֶּחָ֔ה וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסּוֹפֵֽר׃פ

records.literal_gloss: These [were] in [the] days of Joiakim son of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and in [the] days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest, the scribe.

en.L: These [were] in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
en.B: These served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest and scribe.
en.R: These men served when Joiakim son of Jeshua, son of Jozadak, was high priest, and when Nehemiah was governor and Ezra was priest and teacher of the law.

es.L: Estos [fueron] en los días de Joiacim hijo de Jesúa, hijo de Josadac, y en los días de Nehemías el gobernador y de Esdras el sacerdote, el escriba.
es.B: Estos sirvieron en los días de Joiacim hijo de Jesúa, hijo de Josadac, y en los días de Nehemías el gobernador y de Esdras, sacerdote y escriba.
es.R: Estos hombres sirvieron cuando Joiacim hijo de Jesúa, hijo de Josadac, era sumo sacerdote, y cuando Nehemías era gobernador y Esdras era sacerdote y maestro de la ley.

fr.L: Ceux-ci [furent] aux jours de Yoyaqim, fils de Yeshoua, fils de Yotsadaq, et aux jours de Néhémie le gouverneur et d’Esdras le prêtre, le scribe.
fr.B: Ceux-ci servirent au temps de Yoyaqim, fils de Yeshoua, fils de Yotsadaq, et au temps de Néhémie le gouverneur et d’Esdras, prêtre et scribe.
fr.R: Ces hommes ont servi quand Yoyaqim, fils de Yeshoua, fils de Yotsadaq, était grand prêtre, et quand Néhémie était gouverneur et qu’Esdras était prêtre et spécialiste de la Loi.

sw.L: Hawa [walikuwa] katika siku za Yoyakimu mwana wa Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki, na katika siku za Nehemia liwali na za Ezra kuhani, mwandishi.
sw.B: Hawa walihudumu katika siku za Yoyakimu mwana wa Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki, na katika siku za Nehemia liwali na za Ezra kuhani na mwandishi.
sw.R: Watu hawa walihudumu wakati Yoyakimu mwana wa Yeshua, mwana wa Yosadaki, alipokuwa kuhani mkuu, na wakati Nehemia alipokuwa liwali na Ezra alipokuwa kuhani na mwalimu wa sheria.

vi.L: Những người này [ở] trong những ngày của Giô-gia-kim con trai Giê-sua con trai Giô-xa-đác, và trong những ngày của Nê-hê-mi, tổng đốc, và của E-xơ-ra, thầy tế lễ, thầy thông giáo.
vi.B: Những người này phục vụ trong thời Giô-gia-kim con trai Giê-sua con trai Giô-xa-đác, và trong thời tổng đốc Nê-hê-mi và E-xơ-ra, thầy tế lễ và thầy thông giáo.
vi.R: Những người này phục vụ khi Giô-gia-kim con trai Giê-sua, con trai Giô-xa-đác, làm thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và khi Nê-hê-mi làm tổng đốc, còn E-xơ-ra làm thầy tế lễ và thầy dạy luật pháp.

ko.L: 이들은 요사닥의 아들 예수아의 아들 요야김의 날들과, 총독 느헤미야와 제사장이며 서기관인 에스라의 날들에 [있었다].
ko.B: 이들은 요사닥의 아들 예수아의 아들 요야김 때와, 총독 느헤미야와 제사장이자 서기관인 에스라 때에 섬겼다.
ko.R: 이 사람들은 요사닥의 손자이자 예수아의 아들인 요야김이 대제사장이었을 때, 그리고 느헤미야가 총독이고 에스라가 제사장이자 율법 선생이었을 때 섬겼다.

pt.L: Estes [foram] nos dias de Joiaquim, filho de Jesua, filho de Jozadaque, e nos dias de Neemias, o governador, e de Esdras, o sacerdote, o escriba.
pt.B: Estes serviram nos dias de Joiaquim, filho de Jesua, filho de Jozadaque, e nos dias de Neemias, o governador, e de Esdras, o sacerdote e escriba.
pt.R: Esses homens serviram quando Joiaquim, filho de Jesua, filho de Jozadaque, era sumo sacerdote, e quando Neemias era governador e Esdras era sacerdote e mestre da Lei.

decisions.choice: the time span of the lists
decisions.reason: Joiakim was high priest in the generation after the return (verse 10); Nehemiah came as governor in 445 BC (2:1; 5:14), and Ezra had come thirteen years earlier (Ezra 7:7-8). The verse closes the lists of verses 1-25 by tying them to these leaders.

decisions.choice: the scribe: an expert in the law of Moses
decisions.reason: Ezra is called a scribe skilled in the law of Moses (Ezra 7:6, 11). The word means more than a copyist: one who studies and teaches the law.

decisions.choice: These served
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb; "served" says in what sense the people of the lists were "in the days of" these leaders.

decisions.choice: teacher of the law
decisions.reason: Readable's wording for Ezra the scribe, as in Ezra 7:6.

decisions.choice: o escriba (L, B); mestre da Lei (R)
decisions.reason: Ezra's title keeps the Portuguese of Ezra 7:6 and Nehemiah 8:1 at each level (m2); "Jozadaque" as Ezra 3:2.

source.text: וּבַחֲנֻכַּ֞ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם בִּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִכָּל־מְק֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם לַהֲבִיאָ֖ם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשֹׂ֨ת חֲנֻכָּ֤ה וְשִׂמְחָה֙ וּבְתוֹד֣וֹת וּבְשִׁ֔יר מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם נְבָלִ֥ים וּבְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And at [the] dedication of [the] wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites from all their places to bring them to Jerusalem to make [the] dedication and joy, and with thanksgivings and with song, cymbals, harps and with lyres.

en.L: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites from all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to hold the dedication with joy, and with thanksgivings and with song, [with] cymbals, harps and lyres.
en.B: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all the places where they lived and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication with joy, with songs of thanksgiving, and with the music of cymbals, harps, and lyres.
en.R: When the time came to dedicate the wall of Jerusalem, the people looked for the Levites in all the places where they lived and brought them to Jerusalem. They wanted to celebrate the dedication with joy, singing songs of thanks and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres.

es.L: Y en la dedicación del muro de Jerusalén buscaron a los levitas de todos sus lugares, para traerlos a Jerusalén a celebrar la dedicación con alegría, y con acciones de gracias y con canto, [con] címbalos, arpas y liras.
es.B: Para la dedicación del muro de Jerusalén, buscaron a los levitas en todos los lugares donde vivían y los trajeron a Jerusalén para celebrar la dedicación con alegría, con cantos de acción de gracias y con la música de címbalos, arpas y liras.
es.R: Cuando llegó el momento de dedicar el muro de Jerusalén, la gente buscó a los levitas en todos los lugares donde vivían y los llevó a Jerusalén. Querían celebrar la dedicación con alegría, cantando cantos de gratitud y tocando címbalos, arpas y liras.

fr.L: Et lors de la dédicace de la muraille de Jérusalem, on rechercha les Lévites dans tous leurs lieux pour les amener à Jérusalem, afin de célébrer la dédicace avec joie, avec des actions de grâce et avec des chants, [avec] cymbales, harpes et lyres.
fr.B: Pour la dédicace de la muraille de Jérusalem, on rechercha les Lévites dans tous les lieux où ils habitaient et on les amena à Jérusalem pour célébrer la dédicace dans la joie, avec des chants d’action de grâce et au son des cymbales, des harpes et des lyres.
fr.R: Quand le moment est venu de faire la dédicace de la muraille de Jérusalem, on est allé chercher les Lévites dans tous les endroits où ils habitaient et on les a amenés à Jérusalem. On voulait célébrer la dédicace dans la joie, en chantant des chants de remerciement et en jouant des cymbales, des harpes et des lyres.

sw.L: Na wakati wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa ukuta wa Yerusalemu waliwatafuta Walawi kutoka mahali pao pote, ili kuwaleta Yerusalemu kuadhimisha kuwekwa wakfu kwa furaha, na kwa shukrani na kwa wimbo, [kwa] matoazi, zeze na vinubi.
sw.B: Wakati wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa ukuta wa Yerusalemu, Walawi walitafutwa kutoka mahali pote walipoishi, wakaletwa Yerusalemu ili kuadhimisha kuwekwa wakfu huko kwa furaha, kwa nyimbo za shukrani na kwa muziki wa matoazi, zeze na vinubi.
sw.R: Wakati ulipofika wa kuweka wakfu ukuta wa Yerusalemu, watu waliwatafuta Walawi katika mahali pote walipoishi, wakawaleta Yerusalemu. Walitaka kuadhimisha sherehe hiyo kwa furaha, wakiimba nyimbo za shukrani na kupiga matoazi, zeze na vinubi.

vi.L: Và vào lễ khánh thành tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem, người ta tìm người Lê-vi từ mọi nơi ở của họ, để đem họ đến Giê-ru-sa-lem cử hành lễ khánh thành với niềm vui, và với lời cảm tạ và với bài ca, [với] chập chõa, đàn hạc và đàn lia.
vi.B: Khi khánh thành tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem, người ta tìm người Lê-vi ở mọi nơi họ sinh sống và đưa họ về Giê-ru-sa-lem để vui mừng cử hành lễ khánh thành, với những bài ca cảm tạ và tiếng chập chõa, đàn hạc và đàn lia.
vi.R: Khi đến lúc khánh thành tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem, dân chúng đi tìm người Lê-vi ở mọi nơi họ sống và đưa họ về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ muốn cử hành lễ khánh thành thật vui vẻ, hát những bài ca cảm tạ và chơi chập chõa, đàn hạc và đàn lia.

ko.L: 그리고 예루살렘 성벽의 봉헌 때에 그들이 레위 사람들을 그들의 모든 처소에서 찾아 예루살렘으로 데려와, 기쁨으로 봉헌을 행하게 하되, 감사와 노래로, [곧] 심벌즈와 비파와 수금으로 하게 했다.
ko.B: 예루살렘 성벽을 봉헌할 때, 사람들은 레위 사람들이 사는 모든 곳에서 그들을 찾아 예루살렘으로 데려왔다. 감사의 노래를 부르고 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 연주하며 기쁘게 봉헌식을 치르려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 예루살렘 성벽을 하나님께 바칠 때가 되자, 사람들은 레위 사람들이 사는 곳을 모두 찾아다니며 그들을 예루살렘으로 데려왔다. 감사의 노래를 부르고 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 연주하며 기쁘게 봉헌식을 하고 싶었던 것이다.

pt.L: E na dedicação do muro de Jerusalém procuraram os levitas de todos os seus lugares, para trazê-los a Jerusalém, para fazer a dedicação com alegria, e com ações de graças, e com cântico, [com] címbalos, harpas e liras.
pt.B: Na dedicação do muro de Jerusalém, os levitas foram procurados em todos os lugares onde moravam e trazidos a Jerusalém para celebrar a dedicação com alegria, com cânticos de ação de graças e com a música de címbalos, harpas e liras.
pt.R: Quando chegou o tempo de dedicar o muro de Jerusalém, o povo procurou os levitas em todos os lugares onde eles moravam e os trouxe a Jerusalém. Queriam celebrar a dedicação com alegria, cantando cânticos de gratidão e tocando címbalos, harpas e liras.

decisions.choice: dedication: the ceremony that gave the finished wall to God's use
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the dedication of the altar (Numbers 7:84), of Solomon's temple (2 Chronicles 7:9) and of the rebuilt temple (Ezra 6:16-17). The wall was finished in fifty-two days (6:15); this ceremony follows, perhaps some time later, after the repopulation of the city (11:1-2).

decisions.choice: cymbals, harps, lyres: the instruments of temple song
decisions.reason: These three are named together for the Levites' music in David's arrangements (1 Chronicles 15:16; 25:1). The harp and lyre were both stringed instruments; their exact shapes are not certain.

decisions.choice: they sought: an impersonal subject
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; the leaders of the city, or the people as a whole, sent for the Levites. Many Levites lived in towns outside Jerusalem (11:3, 36).

decisions.choice: hold the dedication with joy (Literal); celebrate the dedication with joy (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "to make dedication and joy" means a dedication celebrated with gladness; Literal and Balanced join the two words.

decisions.choice: a dedicação; címbalos, harpas e liras
decisions.reason: "Dedicação" is the word Ezra 6:16 uses in Portuguese for the rebuilt temple (m1): the wall is given to God's use, not only opened. The instruments keep the words of 1 Chronicles 15:16 in Portuguese, "harpa" for the larger stringed instrument and "lira" for the smaller (m2).

source.text: וַיֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ בְּנֵ֖י הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וּמִן־הַכִּכָּר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּמִן־חַצְרֵ֖י נְטֹפָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And were gathered the sons of the singers, both from the circle around Jerusalem and from [the] villages of [the] Netophathite[s],

en.L: And the sons of the singers were gathered, both from the circle around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites,
en.B: And the sons of the singers gathered, both from the district around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites,
en.R: The singers also came together. They came from the area around Jerusalem, from the villages near Netophah,

es.L: Y se reunieron los hijos de los cantores, tanto del círculo alrededor de Jerusalén como de las aldeas de los netofatitas,
es.B: Y se reunieron los hijos de los cantores, tanto de la comarca que rodea Jerusalén como de las aldeas de los netofatitas,
es.R: También se reunieron los cantores. Vinieron de la región alrededor de Jerusalén, de las aldeas cercanas a Netofa,

fr.L: Et les fils des chanteurs se rassemblèrent, tant du cercle autour de Jérusalem que des villages des Netophatites,
fr.B: Et les fils des chanteurs se rassemblèrent, aussi bien de la région qui entoure Jérusalem que des villages des Netophatites,
fr.R: Les chanteurs se sont aussi rassemblés. Ils sont venus des environs de Jérusalem, des villages proches de Netopha,

sw.L: Na wana wa waimbaji wakakusanyika, kutoka eneo la kuzunguka Yerusalemu na kutoka vijiji vya Wanetofathi,
sw.B: Na wana wa waimbaji walikusanyika, kutoka wilaya inayozunguka Yerusalemu na kutoka vijiji vya Wanetofathi,
sw.R: Waimbaji nao walikusanyika. Walikuja kutoka maeneo yaliyozunguka Yerusalemu, kutoka vijiji vilivyo karibu na Netofa,

vi.L: Và các con trai của những người ca hát được nhóm lại, cả từ vùng chung quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem lẫn từ các làng của người Nê-tô-pha,
vi.B: Các con cháu của những người ca hát cũng tụ họp lại, từ vùng chung quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem và từ các làng của người Nê-tô-pha,
vi.R: Những người ca hát cũng tụ họp lại. Họ đến từ vùng chung quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ các làng gần Nê-tô-pha,

ko.L: 그리고 노래하는 사람들의 아들들이 예루살렘 주변의 둘레 지역과 느도바 사람들의 마을들에서,
ko.B: 노래하는 사람들의 자손들도 예루살렘 주변 지역과 느도바 사람들의 마을들에서,
ko.R: 노래하는 사람들도 모였다. 그들은 예루살렘 주변 지역과 느도바 근처의 마을들,

pt.L: E os filhos dos cantores se reuniram, tanto da região ao redor de Jerusalém como das aldeias dos netofatitas,
pt.B: Os filhos dos cantores se reuniram, tanto da região em volta de Jerusalém como das aldeias dos netofatitas,
pt.R: Os cantores também se reuniram. Vieram da região em volta de Jerusalém, das aldeias perto de Netofa,

decisions.choice: the sons of the singers: the members of the singers' guild
decisions.reason: "Sons of" a group means those who belong to it, as "sons of the prophets" means prophets (2 Kings 2:3). The singers were Levite families whose office passed from father to son (1 Chronicles 25).

decisions.choice: the district around Jerusalem; Netophah
decisions.reason: The "circle" is the ring of land and villages around the city. Netophah was a village near Bethlehem; its people returned from exile (Ezra 2:22) and Levites lived in its villages (1 Chronicles 9:16).

decisions.choice: the singers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "the sons of the singers" so the guild idiom stays visible; Readable says simply "the singers".

decisions.choice: the verb "모였다" is held back to the end of verse 29 at Literal and Balanced

decisions.choice: I: Nehemiah's own account begins again
decisions.reason: From here to the end of the book Nehemiah tells the story in the first person, as in chapters 1-7. The lists of chapters 11-12 stand between.

decisions.choice: thanksgiving choirs and processions
decisions.reason: "Thanksgivings" here means choirs that sang thanks (also verses 38 and 40). The next word, found only here, comes from the verb "to walk": processions. Some read the line as "two great choirs, and the procession [of the first went] to the right". Either way two choirs walked on the wall in opposite directions and met at the temple (verse 40).

decisions.choice: to the right, toward the Dung Gate: south
decisions.reason: The Dung Gate was at the southern end of the city (2:13; 3:13-14). The choirs probably set out from the west side, near the Valley Gate, so the first went south and east and the second north (verses 38-39).

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The project's wording for this word for leaders.

decisions.choice: one went; The first went
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say "one"; the verse goes on to describe the route of the first choir, as verse 38 describes the second.

decisions.choice: Nehemiah's account in the first person: "je fis monter" (Literal, Balanced), "j'ai fait monter" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Nehemiah's memoir resumes here (m1); it keeps the tenses of the narrative, passé simple at Literal and Balanced and passé composé at Readable, as Ezra's memoir does.

decisions.choice: "kwaya" (Readable); "makundi ya waimbaji" (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Kwaya" is the everyday word for a choir; Literal and Balanced describe the Hebrew "thanksgivings" as groups of singers.

decisions.choice: "고관들" (Literal), "관리들" (Balanced), "지도자들" (Readable) for the princes of Judah
decisions.reason: The forms published for this word in Ezra 9:1-2 and 10:8; "방백" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: dois grandes [coros] de ação de graças e procissões (L); dois grandes coros de ação de graças (B); dois grandes coros para dar graças (R)
decisions.reason: For verses 31-40: the word "thanksgivings" here names choirs that sang thanks (m2), and "coro" is the Portuguese for a body of singers; Literal brackets it, as the English does, and keeps "procissões" for the rare word from "to walk". The gates keep their names from 2:13-15 and chapter 3 in Portuguese: "a Porta do Monturo", "a Porta da Fonte", "a Porta das Águas" (8:1).

decisions.choice: sons of the priests: priests
decisions.reason: "Sons of the priests" means members of the priestly families, priests themselves; the trumpets were the priests' instruments (Numbers 10:8; Ezra 3:10).

decisions.choice: Zechariah, a descendant of Asaph, leads the Levite musicians
decisions.reason: Asaph was one of David's chief singers (1 Chronicles 16:5; 25:1), so Zechariah was a Levite, not a priest. The trumpeters' names are not given here (compare verse 41); Zechariah heads the Levite musicians of verse 36. Mattaniah is probably the singer of 11:17 and 12:8.

decisions.choice: Then came Zechariah (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable separate Zechariah from the priests with trumpets, following the meaning decision; Literal keeps the colon of the bare list.

decisions.choice: a descendant of Asaph through ...
decisions.reason: Readable turns the chain of six names around so the famous ancestor comes first.

decisions.choice: the chain of fathers runs from Asaph down to Zechariah
decisions.reason: Korean names a man after his forebears ("A의 아들 B"), so the Hebrew chain from son to remote ancestor is turned around, as in the published genealogies of Chronicles; the names and links are the same.

decisions.choice: trombetas
decisions.reason: The priests' metal trumpets (m1), "trombetas" as Numbers 10:8 and Chronicles have them in Portuguese, kept apart from the ram's horn.

records.literal_gloss: and his brothers, Shemaiah and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel and Judah, Hanani, with [the] instruments of song of David, [the] man of God. And Ezra the scribe [was] before them.

en.L: and his brothers, Shemaiah and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel and Judah, Hanani, with the instruments of song of David, the man of God. And Ezra the scribe [was] before them.
en.B: and his brothers Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God. Ezra the scribe walked in front of them.
en.R: and his fellow Levites Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played the kinds of instruments that King David, the man of God, had used for worship. Ezra, the teacher of the law, led this group.

es.L: y sus hermanos, Semaías y Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael y Judá, Hananí, con los instrumentos de canto de David, hombre de Dios. Y Esdras el escriba [iba] delante de ellos.
es.B: y sus hermanos Semaías, Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, Judá y Hananí, con los instrumentos musicales de David, el hombre de Dios. Esdras el escriba iba delante de ellos.
es.R: y sus compañeros levitas Semaías, Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, Judá y Hananí. Tocaban la clase de instrumentos que el rey David, el hombre de Dios, había usado en el culto. Esdras, el maestro de la ley, encabezaba este grupo.

fr.L: et ses frères, Shemaya et Azareel, Milalaï, Guilalaï, Maaï, Netanel et Juda, Hanani, avec les instruments de chant de David, l’homme de Dieu. Et Esdras le scribe [était] devant eux.
fr.B: et ses frères Shemaya, Azareel, Milalaï, Guilalaï, Maaï, Netanel, Juda et Hanani, avec les instruments de musique de David, l’homme de Dieu. Esdras le scribe marchait devant eux.
fr.R: et ses frères lévites Shemaya, Azareel, Milalaï, Guilalaï, Maaï, Netanel, Juda et Hanani. Ils jouaient des instruments comme ceux dont le roi David, l’homme de Dieu, s’était servi pour le culte. Esdras, le spécialiste de la Loi, marchait en tête de ce groupe.

sw.L: na ndugu zake, Shemaya na Azareli, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneli na Yuda, Hanani, wakiwa na vyombo vya wimbo vya Daudi, mtu wa Mungu. Na Ezra mwandishi [alikuwa] mbele yao.
sw.B: na ndugu zake Shemaya, Azareli, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneli, Yuda na Hanani, wakiwa na vyombo vya muziki vya Daudi mtu wa Mungu. Ezra mwandishi alitembea mbele yao.
sw.R: na Walawi wenzake Shemaya, Azareli, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneli, Yuda na Hanani. Walipiga vyombo vya aina ileile ambayo Mfalme Daudi, mtu wa Mungu, alivitumia katika ibada. Ezra, mwalimu wa sheria, aliongoza kundi hili.

ko.L: 그의 형제들 스마야와 아사렐, 밀랄래, 길랄래, 마애, 느다넬과 유다, 하나니가 하나님의 사람 다윗의 노래의 악기들을 가지고 [갔다]. 그리고 서기관 에스라가 그들 앞에 [있었다].
ko.B: 그의 형제들 스마야, 아사렐, 밀랄래, 길랄래, 마애, 느다넬, 유다, 하나니가 하나님의 사람 다윗의 악기들을 들고 갔다. 서기관 에스라는 그들 앞에서 걸어갔다.
ko.R: 그의 동료 레위 사람들인 스마야, 아사렐, 밀랄래, 길랄래, 마애, 느다넬, 유다, 하나니가 따라갔다. 그들은 하나님의 사람 다윗 왕이 예배 때 쓰던 것과 같은 악기들을 연주했다. 율법 선생 에스라가 이 무리를 이끌었다.

pt.L: e os seus irmãos, Semaías, e Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, e Judá, Hanani, com os instrumentos de música de Davi, o homem de Deus. E Esdras, o escriba, [ia] diante deles.

pt.R: e os seus companheiros levitas Semaías, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, Judá e Hanani. Eles tocavam o tipo de instrumentos que o rei Davi, o homem de Deus, tinha usado no culto. Esdras, o mestre da Lei, ia à frente desse grupo.

decisions.choice: the instruments of David
decisions.reason: David is remembered as the one who brought instruments into the worship of God (1 Chronicles 23:5; 2 Chronicles 29:26-27; Amos 6:5).

decisions.choice: Ezra the scribe at the head of the first choir
decisions.reason: Ezra led one procession and Nehemiah followed the other (verse 38), so the two leaders of chapters 8-10 appear together again (8:9).

decisions.choice: teacher of the law
decisions.reason: Readable's wording for Ezra the scribe, as in Ezra 7:6.

decisions.choice: Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Azarel
decisions.reason: Names found only here, spelled by the patterns of Ezra 2 in Portuguese, and a first proposal; Azarel as 11:13 and 1 Chronicles 25:18.

records.literal_gloss: And at [the] Gate of the Spring and straight before them they went up on [the] steps of [the] city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above [the] house of David, and to [the] Gate of the Water[s] [on the] east.

en.L: And at the Gate of the Fountain, and straight before them, they went up on the steps of the City of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, and to the Gate of the Water [on the] east.
en.B: At the Fountain Gate they went straight up the steps of the City of David, where the wall goes up, above the house of David, and on to the Water Gate on the east.
en.R: At the Fountain Gate they went straight ahead and climbed the steps that lead up to the City of David. They followed the wall as it rose, past the place above David's palace, and went on as far as the Water Gate on the east side of the city.

es.L: Y en la puerta de la Fuente, y derecho delante de ellos, subieron por las escaleras de la ciudad de David, en la subida del muro, por encima de la casa de David, y hasta la puerta de las Aguas, [al] oriente.
es.B: En la puerta de la Fuente subieron derecho por las escaleras de la ciudad de David, donde sube el muro, por encima de la casa de David, y siguieron hasta la puerta de las Aguas, al oriente.
es.R: En la puerta de la Fuente siguieron derecho y subieron por las escaleras que llevan a la ciudad de David. Siguieron el muro donde este sube, pasaron por encima del lugar del palacio de David y llegaron hasta la puerta de las Aguas, en el lado oriental de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et à la porte de la Source, et droit devant eux, ils montèrent par les marches de la cité de David, à la montée de la muraille, au-dessus de la maison de David, et jusqu’à la porte des Eaux, [à] l’est.
fr.B: À la porte de la Source, ils montèrent tout droit les marches de la cité de David, là où la muraille s’élève, au-dessus de la maison de David, et continuèrent jusqu’à la porte des Eaux, à l’est.
fr.R: À la porte de la Source, ils ont continué tout droit et ont gravi les marches qui montent à la cité de David. Ils ont suivi la muraille là où elle monte, sont passés au-dessus de l’endroit du palais de David et sont allés jusqu’à la porte des Eaux, du côté est de la ville.

sw.L: Na kwenye Lango la Chemchemi, na moja kwa moja mbele yao, wakapanda kwa ngazi za mji wa Daudi, kwenye mwinuko wa ukuta, juu ya nyumba ya Daudi, na mpaka Lango la Maji [upande wa] mashariki.
sw.B: Walipofika Lango la Chemchemi walipanda moja kwa moja kwa ngazi za mji wa Daudi, mahali ukuta unapopanda, juu ya nyumba ya Daudi, wakaendelea mpaka Lango la Maji upande wa mashariki.
sw.R: Kwenye Lango la Chemchemi walienda moja kwa moja, wakapanda ngazi zinazoelekea mji wa Daudi. Walifuata ukuta ulipokuwa ukipanda, wakapita juu ya mahali pa jumba la Daudi, wakaendelea mpaka Lango la Maji upande wa mashariki wa mji.

vi.L: Và tại Cổng Suối, và thẳng trước mặt họ, họ đi lên các bậc thang của thành Đa-vít, tại chỗ dốc của tường thành, phía trên nhà của Đa-vít, và đến Cổng Nước [ở phía] đông.
vi.B: Đến Cổng Suối, họ đi thẳng lên các bậc thang của thành Đa-vít, nơi tường thành đi lên, phía trên nhà của Đa-vít, rồi tiếp tục đến Cổng Nước ở phía đông.
vi.R: Đến Cổng Suối, họ đi thẳng tới và leo lên các bậc thang dẫn lên thành Đa-vít. Họ đi theo tường thành nơi nó dốc lên, qua phía trên chỗ cung điện của Đa-vít, và đi tiếp cho đến Cổng Nước ở phía đông thành.

ko.L: 그리고 샘 문에서, 그들 앞으로 곧장, 그들은 성벽의 오르막에서 다윗 성의 계단들을 올라, 다윗의 집 위로 [지나], 동쪽 수문까지 [갔다].
ko.B: 그들은 샘 문에서 곧장 다윗 성의 계단을 올라, 성벽이 올라가는 곳에서 다윗의 집 위를 지나, 동쪽 수문까지 갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 샘 문에서 곧장 앞으로 나아가 다윗 성으로 올라가는 계단을 올랐다. 그리고 성벽이 높아지는 길을 따라 다윗의 궁전 자리 위를 지나, 성의 동쪽에 있는 수문까지 갔다.

pt.L: E na Porta da Fonte, e bem diante deles, subiram pelos degraus da Cidade de Davi, na subida do muro, acima da casa de Davi, até a Porta das Águas, ao oriente.
pt.B: Na Porta da Fonte, eles subiram direto pelos degraus da Cidade de Davi, onde o muro sobe, acima da casa de Davi, e seguiram até a Porta das Águas, a leste.
pt.R: Na Porta da Fonte, eles seguiram em frente e subiram os degraus que levam à Cidade de Davi. Acompanharam o muro onde ele subia, passaram pelo lugar acima do palácio de Davi e foram até a Porta das Águas, no lado leste da cidade.

decisions.choice: the route of the first choir
decisions.reason: The Fountain Gate, the steps going down from the City of David and the Water Gate are all named in the account of the rebuilding (3:15, 26). The choir walked north along the eastern side of the old City of David toward the temple.

decisions.choice: straight before them: straight ahead
decisions.reason: The phrase means going straight on without turning aside. Some join it with the preceding words: "at the Fountain Gate, in front of them".

decisions.choice: the house of David: David's palace
decisions.reason: The royal house David built (2 Samuel 5:11), by then perhaps only its ruins or its site. The wall ran above it.

decisions.choice: past the place above David's palace
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the sense that the wall passed above the palace site, without deciding whether the palace still stood.

source.text: וְהַתּוֹדָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית הַהוֹלֶ֥כֶת לְמ֖וֹאל וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יהָ וַחֲצִ֨י הָעָ֜ם מֵעַ֣ל לְהַחוֹמָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ לְמִגְדַּ֣ל הַתַּנּוּרִ֔ים וְעַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the thanksgiving [choir], the second, [was] going opposite, and I after it, and half of the people, on top of the wall, above the Tower of the Ovens and to the wall, the Broad,

en.L: And the second thanksgiving [choir was] going opposite, and I after it, and half of the people, on top of the wall, above the Tower of the Ovens and as far as the Broad Wall,
en.B: The second choir went the opposite way, and I followed it with half of the people, on top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
en.R: The second choir went the other way along the wall, to the left. I followed it with half of the people. We passed the Tower of the Ovens and came to the Broad Wall.

es.L: Y el segundo [coro] de acción de gracias [iba] en dirección opuesta, y yo tras él, y la mitad del pueblo, sobre el muro, por encima de la torre de los Hornos y hasta el Muro Ancho,
es.B: El segundo coro fue en dirección opuesta, y yo lo seguí con la mitad del pueblo, sobre el muro, pasando la torre de los Hornos hasta el Muro Ancho,
es.R: El segundo coro fue por el muro en la otra dirección, hacia la izquierda. Yo lo seguí con la mitad del pueblo. Pasamos la torre de los Hornos y llegamos al Muro Ancho.

fr.L: Et le second [chœur] d’action de grâce [allait] en sens opposé, et moi derrière lui, avec la moitié du peuple, sur la muraille, au-dessus de la tour des Fours et jusqu’à la Muraille large,
fr.B: Le second chœur alla dans l’autre sens, et je le suivis avec la moitié du peuple, sur la muraille, au-delà de la tour des Fours jusqu’à la Muraille large,
fr.R: Le second chœur est parti de l’autre côté, vers la gauche, sur la muraille. Je l’ai suivi avec la moitié du peuple. Nous sommes passés devant la tour des Fours et nous sommes arrivés à la Muraille large.

sw.L: Na kundi [la waimbaji] wa shukrani la pili [lilikuwa] likienda upande wa pili, nami nyuma yake, na nusu ya watu, juu ya ukuta, juu ya Mnara wa Tanuri na mpaka Ukuta Mpana,
sw.B: Kundi la pili la waimbaji lilikwenda upande wa pili, nami nikalifuata pamoja na nusu ya watu, juu ya ukuta, tukapita Mnara wa Tanuri mpaka Ukuta Mpana,
sw.R: Kwaya ya pili ilikwenda upande mwingine wa ukuta, kuelekea kushoto. Mimi niliifuata pamoja na nusu ya watu. Tulipita Mnara wa Tanuri, tukafika kwenye Ukuta Mpana.

vi.L: Và [ban hát] cảm tạ thứ hai [đi] về phía đối diện, và tôi đi sau nó, cùng một nửa dân chúng, trên tường thành, phía trên tháp Lò Bánh và cho đến Tường Rộng,
vi.B: Ban hát thứ hai đi về hướng ngược lại, và tôi đi theo sau cùng với một nửa dân chúng, trên tường thành, qua khỏi tháp Lò Bánh đến Tường Rộng,
vi.R: Ban hát thứ hai đi theo tường thành về hướng kia, tức là bên trái. Tôi đi theo sau với một nửa dân chúng. Chúng tôi đi qua tháp Lò Bánh và đến Tường Rộng.

ko.L: 그리고 둘째 감사 [찬양대]는 반대편으로 갔고, 나와 백성의 절반은 그 뒤에서 성벽 위로, 화덕 망대 위를 지나 넓은 성벽까지,
ko.B: 둘째 찬양대는 반대 방향으로 갔고, 나는 백성의 절반과 함께 그 뒤를 따라 성벽 위로 화덕 망대를 지나 넓은 성벽까지,
ko.R: 둘째 찬양대는 성벽 위를 따라 반대쪽, 곧 왼쪽으로 갔다. 나는 백성의 절반과 함께 그 뒤를 따랐다. 우리는 화덕 망대를 지나 넓은 성벽에 이르렀다.

pt.L: E o segundo [coro] de ação de graças ia no sentido oposto, e eu atrás dele, e metade do povo, sobre o muro, acima da Torre dos Fornos, até o Muro Largo,
pt.B: O segundo coro foi no sentido oposto, e eu o segui com metade do povo, sobre o muro, passando pela Torre dos Fornos até o Muro Largo,
pt.R: O segundo coro foi pelo muro no sentido oposto, para a esquerda. Eu o segui com metade do povo. Passamos pela Torre dos Fornos e chegamos ao Muro Largo.

decisions.choice: opposite: in the other direction
decisions.reason: The word usually means "in front of" or "facing"; here it means the direction opposite to the first choir, which went to the right (verse 31). The second choir went north along the western wall.

decisions.choice: the Tower of the Ovens and the Broad Wall
decisions.reason: Both are named in the account of the rebuilding of the west and north walls (3:8, 11).

decisions.choice: to the left
decisions.reason: Readable adds what "opposite" means here, from verse 31.

decisions.choice: a Torre dos Fornos; o Muro Largo
decisions.reason: The tower and the wall named in the rebuilding (3:8, 11; m2) are written as names, with capitals, as the gates are.

source.text: וּמֵעַ֣ל לְשַֽׁעַר־אֶ֠פְרַיִם וְעַל־שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה וְעַל־שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֗ים וּמִגְדַּ֤ל חֲנַנְאֵל֙ וּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַמֵּאָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֑אןוְעָ֣מְד֔וּ בְּשַׁ֖עַר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and from above [the] Gate of Ephraim and over [the] Gate of the Jeshanah and over the Gate of the Fish and [the] Tower of Hananel and [the] Tower of the Hundred, and to the Gate of the Sheep; and they stood at [the] Gate of the Guard.

en.L: and above the Gate of Ephraim and over the Gate of the Jeshanah and over the Gate of the Fish and the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, and as far as the Gate of the Sheep; and they stood still at the Gate of the Guard.
en.B: and above the Ephraim Gate, past the Jeshanah Gate and the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
en.R: Then we went past the Ephraim Gate, the Jeshanah Gate, and the Fish Gate, past the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. The choir stopped at the Gate of the Guard.

es.L: y por encima de la puerta de Efraín, y por encima de la puerta de Jesaná, y por encima de la puerta del Pescado, y la torre de Hananel y la torre de los Cien, y hasta la puerta de las Ovejas; y se detuvieron en la puerta de la Guardia.
es.B: y por encima de la puerta de Efraín, pasando la puerta de Jesaná y la puerta del Pescado, la torre de Hananel y la torre de los Cien, hasta la puerta de las Ovejas. Y se detuvieron en la puerta de la Guardia.
es.R: Luego pasamos la puerta de Efraín, la puerta de Jesaná y la puerta del Pescado, la torre de Hananel y la torre de los Cien, hasta llegar a la puerta de las Ovejas. El coro se detuvo en la puerta de la Guardia.

fr.L: et au-dessus de la porte d’Éphraïm, et sur la porte de Yeshana, et sur la porte des Poissons, et la tour de Hananéel, et la tour des Cent, et jusqu’à la porte des Brebis ; et ils s’arrêtèrent à la porte de la Garde.
fr.B: et au-dessus de la porte d’Éphraïm, au-delà de la porte de Yeshana et de la porte des Poissons, de la tour de Hananéel et de la tour des Cent, jusqu’à la porte des Brebis. Et ils s’arrêtèrent à la porte de la Garde.
fr.R: Ensuite, nous sommes passés devant la porte d’Éphraïm, la porte de Yeshana et la porte des Poissons, devant la tour de Hananéel et la tour des Cent, jusqu’à la porte des Brebis. Le chœur s’est arrêté à la porte de la Garde.

sw.L: na juu ya Lango la Efraimu, na juu ya Lango la Yeshana, na juu ya Lango la Samaki, na Mnara wa Hananeli na Mnara wa Mia, na mpaka Lango la Kondoo; nao wakasimama kwenye Lango la Walinzi.
sw.B: na juu ya Lango la Efraimu, tukapita Lango la Yeshana na Lango la Samaki, Mnara wa Hananeli na Mnara wa Mia, mpaka Lango la Kondoo. Nao wakasimama kwenye Lango la Walinzi.
sw.R: Kisha tukapita Lango la Efraimu, Lango la Yeshana na Lango la Samaki, tukapita Mnara wa Hananeli na Mnara wa Mia, mpaka Lango la Kondoo. Kwaya ilisimama kwenye Lango la Walinzi.

vi.L: và phía trên Cổng Ép-ra-im, và trên Cổng Giê-sa-na, và trên Cổng Cá, và tháp Ha-na-nên, và tháp Một Trăm, và cho đến Cổng Chiên; và họ dừng lại tại Cổng Vệ Binh.
vi.B: và phía trên Cổng Ép-ra-im, qua Cổng Giê-sa-na và Cổng Cá, tháp Ha-na-nên và tháp Một Trăm, cho đến Cổng Chiên. Rồi họ dừng lại tại Cổng Vệ Binh.
vi.R: Rồi chúng tôi đi qua Cổng Ép-ra-im, Cổng Giê-sa-na và Cổng Cá, qua tháp Ha-na-nên và tháp Một Trăm, cho đến Cổng Chiên. Ban hát dừng lại tại Cổng Vệ Binh.

ko.L: 그리고 에브라임 문 위와 여사나 문 위와 물고기 문 위와 하나넬 망대와 함메아 망대를 지나 양 문까지 [갔다]. 그리고 그들이 경비대 문에서 멈추어 섰다.
ko.B: 에브라임 문 위를 지나고, 여사나 문과 물고기 문, 하나넬 망대와 함메아 망대를 지나 양 문까지 갔다. 그리고 경비대 문에서 멈추었다.
ko.R: 그런 다음 우리는 에브라임 문, 여사나 문, 물고기 문을 지나고, 하나넬 망대와 함메아 망대를 지나 양 문까지 갔다. 찬양대는 경비대 문에서 멈추었다.

pt.L: e acima da Porta de Efraim, e sobre a Porta Velha, e sobre a Porta dos Peixes, e a Torre de Hananel, e a Torre dos Cem, e até a Porta das Ovelhas; e pararam na Porta da Guarda.
pt.B: e por cima da Porta de Efraim, passando pela Porta Velha e pela Porta dos Peixes, pela Torre de Hananel e pela Torre dos Cem, até a Porta das Ovelhas. E pararam na Porta da Guarda.
pt.R: Depois passamos pela Porta de Efraim, pela Porta Velha e pela Porta dos Peixes, pela Torre de Hananel e pela Torre dos Cem, até a Porta das Ovelhas. O coro parou na Porta da Guarda.

decisions.choice: the route of the second choir along the north wall
decisions.reason: These gates and towers are named in the account of the rebuilding of the north side of the city (3:1-6; the Ephraim Gate in 8:16 and 2 Kings 14:13). The procession ended near the temple, at its northern side.

decisions.choice: the Jeshanah Gate: perhaps the Old Gate
decisions.reason: The name can mean "the old [gate]", or it may name the gate on the road to the town of Jeshanah (2 Chronicles 13:19). The same gate is named in 3:6.

decisions.choice: the Gate of the Guard
decisions.reason: This gate is named only here; it was probably a temple gate near the place where the guard was kept (compare "the court of the guard", 3:25). Its site is not known.

decisions.choice: The choir stopped
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject of "they stood", the second choir.

decisions.choice: "함메아 망대", the Hebrew name kept
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the tower's Hebrew name, as published Korean does; "함메아" means "the Hundred", the meaning the other languages translate. Why it was so called is not known.

decisions.choice: a Porta Velha, a Porta dos Peixes, a Torre de Hananel, a Torre dos Cem, a Porta das Ovelhas; a Porta da Guarda
decisions.reason: The gates and towers of the north wall keep their names from 3:1-6 in Portuguese (m1), "a Porta Velha" for the Jeshanah Gate as set there (m2), though the English keeps the Hebrew name. The Gate of the Guard is named only here (m3), and "guarda" is the word of "o pátio da guarda" in 3:25.

source.text: וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י הַתּוֹדֹ֖ת בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֕י וַחֲצִ֥י הַסְּגָנִ֖ים עִמִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And stood the two thanksgiving [choirs] in [the] house of God, and I and half of the officials with me,

en.L: And the two thanksgiving [choirs] stood in the house of God, and I and half of the officials with me,
en.B: So the two choirs that gave thanks took their places in the house of God. So did I, with half of the officials,
en.R: Then both choirs took their places in God's temple. I did the same, along with half of the officials,

es.L: Y los dos [coros] de acción de gracias se pararon en la casa de Dios, y yo y la mitad de los oficiales conmigo,
es.B: Así los dos coros de acción de gracias ocuparon su lugar en la casa de Dios. También yo, con la mitad de los oficiales,
es.R: Después los dos coros ocuparon su lugar en el templo de Dios. Yo hice lo mismo, junto con la mitad de los funcionarios,

fr.L: Et les deux [chœurs] d’action de grâce se tinrent dans la maison de Dieu, et moi et la moitié des magistrats avec moi,
fr.B: Les deux chœurs d’action de grâce prirent alors place dans la maison de Dieu. Je fis de même, avec la moitié des magistrats,
fr.R: Ensuite, les deux chœurs ont pris place dans le temple de Dieu. J’ai fait de même, avec la moitié des responsables,

sw.L: Na makundi mawili [ya waimbaji] wa shukrani yakasimama katika nyumba ya Mungu, nami na nusu ya maafisa pamoja nami,
sw.B: Hivyo makundi mawili ya waimbaji wa shukrani yalichukua nafasi zao katika nyumba ya Mungu. Nami nikafanya vivyo hivyo, pamoja na nusu ya maafisa,
sw.R: Kisha kwaya zote mbili zilichukua nafasi zao katika hekalu la Mungu. Nami nikafanya vivyo hivyo, pamoja na nusu ya maafisa,

vi.L: Và hai [ban hát] cảm tạ đứng trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời, và tôi cùng một nửa các quan chức với tôi,
vi.B: Vậy hai ban hát cảm tạ vào vị trí của mình trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời. Tôi cũng vậy, cùng với một nửa các quan chức,
vi.R: Rồi cả hai ban hát vào chỗ của mình trong đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời. Tôi cũng làm như vậy, cùng với một nửa các quan chức,

ko.L: 그리고 두 감사 [찬양대]가 하나님의 집에 섰고, 나와 나와 함께한 관리들의 절반과,
ko.B: 이렇게 감사하는 두 찬양대가 하나님의 집에서 자리를 잡았다. 나도 관리들의 절반과 함께 자리를 잡았고,
ko.R: 두 찬양대는 하나님의 성전에서 자리를 잡았다. 나도 관리들의 절반과 함께 그렇게 했고,

pt.L: E os dois [coros] de ação de graças pararam na casa de Deus, e eu e metade dos oficiais comigo,
pt.B: Assim os dois coros que davam graças tomaram os seus lugares na casa de Deus. Eu também fiz o mesmo, com metade dos oficiais,
pt.R: Então os dois coros tomaram os seus lugares no templo de Deus. Eu fiz o mesmo, com metade dos oficiais,

decisions.choice: the two choirs meet at the temple
decisions.reason: Having gone around the city on its walls in opposite directions, the two processions met in the courts of the temple, where the sacrifices of verse 43 were offered.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The word is one of the two used in Nehemiah for the leaders of the community (2:16; 4:8), here the same group called "the princes of Judah" in verses 31-32.

decisions.choice: God's temple
decisions.reason: Readable's wording for "the house of God".

decisions.choice: os oficiais (every level)
decisions.reason: The word here is the one Nehemiah 2:16 pairs with the nobles, "os oficiais" at every level in Portuguese (m2); verses 31-32 have the other word for leaders, "príncipes", "oficiais" and "líderes" by level.
